requirements.requirement: Define the slice's subjects, policies, legal transitions, effects, required admissions and outcomes. Test applicable denial, transition, acknowledgement, retry and cancellation behavior; review proportional nonapplicability.
Use typed owned boundaries, controlled time and I/O, cohesive operation paths and mirrored tests. Review legitimate dynamic or pure-static exceptions; do not create unused abstractions.
Preserve accepted ownership and exact dependency decisions. Link each exception to explicit accepted authority and current verification.
Verify evaluated project and compiled type dependencies, Core purity, feature activation and resolution, and compatibility of owned extension protocols.
Bind explicit wire/JSON admission semantics to DTOs and registered OpenAPI production; preserve versioned behavior with compatibility tests, not structural diff alone.
Materialize the selected UI profile and exercise the actual browser journey, accessibility and declared security boundary. Generated examples are not product acceptance.
For each selected capability prove materialization, configured activation and actual supported public mechanism use; distinguish build-time producers from deployed runtime services.
